The '''Regulan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located near the planets [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]] and [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. It housed the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Blaudu Octus]] and [[Blaudu Sextus]], where an [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|uprising]] occurred in [[44 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the "Blaudu Sextus system" mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas Online Companion'']] (in the Prefsbelt sector) was a mistake. [[Blaudu Sextus]] was in the Regulan system, correctly listed in the appendix.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31605450|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2011-03-19|time=7:30 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802124300/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-162}}</ref>
